newsitem.title: CHINA: China to ship 1.5 mln T of corn to south regions.
newsitem.headline: China to ship 1.5 mln T of corn to south regions.

text.p: China has given permission for the shipment of 1.5 million tonnes of corn from the northeastern producing provinces of Heilongjiang and Jilin to other regions, officials said on Friday.

Each province was to provide 750,000 tonnes of the corn to be shipped to Beijing, the northern port city of Tianjin and Shanghai as well as other provinces, an official of the State Grain Reserve Administration said.
This decision was taken by the State Council, or cabinet, in late December, officials said.
The shipments had already begun, they said.
The aim of the distribution was to boost prices in producing provinces, said one official reached by telephone in Heilongjiang.

The State Council had also arranged for the allocation of 2.5 million tonnes of corn to be sold at market prices to other provinces, the China Grains, Oils and Feeds Information newsletter said in its latest edition available on Friday.
